Consider the following sets of simultaneous equations.

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="45%"}

**Set 1**

Solve 
$$
\begin{align}
4x_1 + 2x_2 &= -3 \\
2x_1 + x_2 &= 2
\end{align}
$$
for $x_1$ and $x_2$.

:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="45%"}

**Set 2**

Solve 
$$
\begin{align}
4x_1 + 2x_2 &= -3 \\
2x_1 - x_2 &= 2
\end{align}
$$
for $x_1$ and $x_2$.

:::
:::

**Classifying Matrices**

In the following, identify:

1. the matrices that are likely to have a unique solution to $Ax=b$
2. the matrices that represent systems of equations that can be solved using the Jacobi method
3. the matrices that represent systems of equations that can be solved using $LU$ factorization (after rearranging the rows if necessary)

$$
B_1 = \begin{bmatrix}
1 & 2 & 3 \\
0 & 1 & 4 \\
5 & 6 & 0
\end{bmatrix}, \quad 
B_2 = \begin{bmatrix}
2 & -1 & 0 \\
1 & 3 & 2 \\
0 & -2 & 1
\end{bmatrix}$$

$$
B_3 = \begin{bmatrix}
2 & 1 & -1 & 3 \\
0 & 3 & 1 & 4 \\
4 & 2 & -2 & 6 \\
1 & 0 & 2 & -1
\end{bmatrix}, \quad
B_4 = \begin{bmatrix}
1 & 2 & 0 & 3 \\
2 & -1 & 4 & 1 \\
1 & 1 & 2 & 1 \\
2 & 0 & 2 & 3
\end{bmatrix}, \quad 
B_5 = \begin{bmatrix}
1 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\
0 & 1 & -1 & 2 \\
2 & 1 & 0 & 1 \\
1 & 3 & 1 & 0
\end{bmatrix}
$$


{{< pagebreak >}}

For each of the following systems of equations,

1. Solve the equations for $x$ and $y$.
2. Find the determinant of the associated matrix
3. Calculate the condition number.

::: {.callout-tip}

Note that the matrix $$\begin{bmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{bmatrix}$$ has determinant $|ad-bc|$ and its inverse is $$\frac{1}{|ad-bc|} \begin{bmatrix} d & -b  \\ -c & a \end{bmatrix}$$
:::


::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="30%"}

**Set 1**

$$
\begin{align}
2x + y &= 3 \\
2x+1.001y &= 0
\end{align}
$$

:::

::: {.column width="30%"}

**Set 2**

$$
\begin{align}
2x + y &= 3 \\
2x+1.002y &= 0
\end{align}
$$

:::

::: {.column width="30%"}

**Set 3**

$$
\begin{align}
2x + y &= 3 \\
2x+1.001y &= -0.001
\end{align}
$$

:::

:::
